- [Agent Registry](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-agent-tool): tool - Register/update or look up an agent in the multi-agent registry (#684). Agents carry a trust tier (0-3) that gates sensitive ops (e.g. authoring keystones needs tier >= 2) and drives visibility enforcement on recall: tier 0 = read own only, 1 = fleet, 2 = read all + write keystones, 3 = admin. Pass trust_tier (and optionally name/fleet_id) to upsert; omit trust_tier to just look up. entities/journal already stamp agent_id (v1.2.0); this adds the identity + tier metadata. NOTE: an empty/unknown agent has no registry row — unknown identified agents resolve to tier 0, and a caller with no session identity is unscoped.
- [Set Action Authority](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-authority-set-tool): tool - Create a versioned authority manifest for a registered agent.
- [Get Action Authority](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-authority-get-tool): tool - Get the active authority manifest for an agent and workspace.
- [Revoke Action Authority](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-authority-revoke-tool): tool - Revoke an authority manifest.
- [Load Signed Authority Profile](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-authority-set-signed-tool): tool - Load a signed, distributable policy/authority profile (Ed25519 sigstore-style attestation); verification failure grants no authority (fail closed) and the verification result lands in the ledger journal.
- [Record Action Intent](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-action-intent-tool): tool - Record a fail-closed authorized action intent.
- [Decide Action Approval](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-action-approve-tool): tool - Grant or deny an approval-requested action.
- [Complete Authorized Action](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-action-complete-tool): tool - Record an executed, failed, cancelled, or denied action outcome by hash.
- [Resolve Approval Timeout](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-action-resolve-timeout-tool): tool - Resolve a pending approval to deny once its window has expired (timeout defaults to deny).
- [Get Action Receipt](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-action-receipt-get-tool): tool - Get durable action receipt metadata and hashes.
- [Acquire Action Lease](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-action-lease-acquire-tool): tool - Acquire the single active lease for an action key.
- [Release Action Lease](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-action-lease-release-tool): tool - Release an action lease held by its owner.
- [Validate Runtime Stage Trace](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-stage-trace-validate-tool): tool - Validate a versioned hash-only runtime stage trace and optionally compare replay semantics. Raw prompts, memory bodies, credentials, and tool payloads are not accepted.
- [Validate Context Transform](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-context-transform-validate-tool): tool - #1106: validate a versioned context-transformer proposal at the provider boundary. Returns only a hash-only receipt, bounded changed-span metadata, explicit outcome/lossiness, and replay/original references; raw messages, prompts, memory bodies, credentials, and tool payloads are not returned.
- [Reject Value](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-reject-value-tool): tool - Record a scoped digest-only rejected-value tombstone. Equivalent values remain rejected across new entity keys and writer paths until the tombstone expires or is explicitly superseded.
- [Audit Extraction Loss (Residual Spans)](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-span-audit-tool): tool - Extraction-loss net (#1048): audit an entity for fact-bearing sentences its extracted claims missed, retaining them verbatim as residual spans with provenance (embedding-first similarity, token fallback — no extra LLM call). Append-only; re-audits never duplicate. Spans are regular, decay/hygiene-subject memory state — never auto-served into recall.
- [Report Refusal (Retry Payload)](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-report-refusal-tool): tool - Extraction-loss net (#1048): an answerer's refusal over a served payload is evidence. Re-scores the served entities' residual spans against the original query and returns a retry payload (spans whose query-similarity beats the entity's own by a margin — the anomaly rule). Units with no retry material accumulate lossy marks; at the threshold they are flagged for repair-on-touch.
- [Report Success (Confirm Query Key)](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-report-success-tool): tool - Extraction-loss net (#1048): confirm a retry payload answered the query. Attaches a provisional query key (query fingerprint to entity ids) so an identical repeat query serves first-pass; served spans become confirmed; lossy units are cleared to repaired. The binding is durable until superseded by another report_success for the same query.
- [Dependency-Guided Rollback Repair](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-rollback-repair-tool): tool - #1084 (arXiv:2608.10502): dependency-guided rollback repair for poisoned/stale memories. Builds a typed memory→action dependency graph from runtime provenance, preserves dependents with independent trusted support, tombstones unsupported state (quarantine — never deletes), and reports a scoped selective-replay proposal. Every step is journal-receipted and the repair is reversible (reverse_repair_id).
- [Set Signer Epoch Key](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-signer-epoch-set-tool): tool - #1080 (MutMem): register or replace the Ed25519 signing key for a signer epoch — the authorization root for signed transitions. The seed (32 raw bytes, base64) is stored at rest alongside the database (same trust domain as the AES key file) and never echoed back. Ops scope.
- [Set Poison Label](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-poison-label-tool): tool - #1080 (MutMem): set or revise a SIGNED poison label on a stored entity. Poison-likely content is retained (never silently deleted); recall consumes the label as trust evidence (poison_likely −90% effective score, suspect −50%, clean = restored). Every label write commits as a signed transition — fails closed when no signer epoch is registered.
- [Audit Signed Transition Chain](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-transition-audit-tool): tool - #1080 (MutMem): replay the signed-transition chain end to end — every record must verify against its epoch key, link to the previous chain hash (no forks), and reproduce its own chain hash. Reports record count, verified count, chain head, and the first divergence (if any).
- [Define Retrieval Skill](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-skill-set-tool): tool - #1090 (ERSkill, arXiv:2608.12720): define or version a retrieval skill — a validated parameterization of recall primitives (mode, typed filters, trust/content weights, recency). New versions always enter the expansion frontier (double-frontier deployment): they never affect routing until a governed advancement.
- [Route Retrieval Query](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-skill-route-tool): tool - #1090 (ERSkill): deterministic per-query routing over the SERVING frontier only — feature-based scoring, ties break by skill id. With serve=true the chosen skill executes (recall with its template) and the explored path is logged into the experience trie (skill id × query fingerprint × outcome).
- [Advance Retrieval Skill Frontier](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-skill-advance-tool): tool - #1090 (ERSkill): governed double-frontier transition. advance (expansion→serving) REQUIRES non-regression evidence (wins/losses/ties + recall_delta) and is refused fail-closed on regression; demote (serving→expansion) is the governed rollback. Every transition is receipt-anchored and bumps the serving version.
- [Audit Retrieval Skills](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-skill-audit-tool): tool - #1090 (ERSkill): read-only audit of the skill registry — definitions by frontier, serving version, experience-trie stats per skill, and the receipt trail (definitions, advancements, refusals).
- [Audit Temporal Decay](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-decay-audit-tool): tool - #1091 (ScrubJay-MEM, arXiv:2608.04746): audit type-conditioned temporal decay — the deterministic perishability/utility-horizon profile table per memory type plus population aggregates (count, mean decay, mean age, past-horizon rows excluded from default recall).
- [Segment-Level Consolidation](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-segment-consolidate-tool): tool - #1088 (LycheeMemory V2, arXiv:2608.12990): semantic segment-level consolidation — batch entities into semantic segments via deterministic boundary detection (inter-arrival gap + adjacent trigram discontinuity, never fixed windows), then run ONE bounded consolidate pass per finalized segment (>=2 members). Construction frequency is segment-count-bound, not write-count-bound. Segment plans are indexed under state keys segment_plan.<id>.
- [Audit State Staleness](/vault/mcp-reference/mcp-tools.html#operation-perseus-vault-state-audit-tool): tool - #1093 (STALE/StateAuditor, arXiv:2608.01619): audit state-table entries for implicit stale-dependency drift (sleep proposals whose entities vanished, experience-stats drift, cached entity-count drift, shadow-promote records) and repair by state-to-draft demotion — originals preserved verbatim under state_draft.*, live keys marked stale, journal receipts anchored. dry_run=true only reports.
